findings.title: Eligibility uses stale PhysicsServer shape after same-instance Node transform change
reproduction: Start actual Input F on registered bench at actor280,240 / prop308,240.
Foot audio listener shifts same enabled registered prop Node by(0,16), without force_update_transform.
Inspect current CollisionShape global transform with direct Shape2D.collide and observer after Core in same tick19.
findings.positive_control: Same shift plus force_update_transform makes server/current shape agree; Core movement0, jobs0.
findings.required_fix: Production eligibility must use collision geometry consistent with the current Node transforms subsequently moved, including callback changes; syncing only QA callback is not a product fix. Preserve range/facing/LOS and atomic no-contact abort.
findings.required_actual_validation: Unchanged QA07 no-force case must show current shape miss and zero additional actor/prop movement/job0 in the same tick; force-control and normal sweeps must still pass.

findings.title: Old-job cleanup cancels a legitimate replacement action after epoch reset and reused numeric attack ID
reproduction: Foot callback invokes ordinary combat.reset(), player.reset(current_position), set_aim(RIGHT), use_ability(); no forced attack-ID assignment.
Normal reset advances epoch6→7 and resets allocator; valid new special action obtains id1 again.
Return to old job cleanup; observe same tick137 after Core.
findings.required_fix: Cancel only the exact original action/job lifetime, binding epoch and original authority/action identity as well as numeric ID; old cleanup must not erase or cancel a new valid lifetime.
findings.required_actual_validation: Unchanged QA07 reset/new-same-kind case must preserve new epoch7/id1 special job/action after the old job returns, with no stale old step/receipt. Preserve different-ID shove and prior reset/free/cancel cases.

partially_remediated.closed_scope: Original unchanged QA05/06 far-source/far-prop128px cases: stale0.700012px→zero in same tick. LOS invalidation and different-ID shove guard pass.
partially_remediated.remaining: Current-Node/cache consistency and epoch-safe cleanup above block broad closure.
